item.title: À Gaza, une fresque honore le rappeur Macklemore pour son soutien aux Palestiniens
item.description: Une fresque représentant le rappeur américain Macklemore enveloppé dans un drapeau palestinien a été peinte par des artistes gazaouis sur une large dalle de béton au milieu des ruines de l'enclave, afin d'honorer le chanteur pour son soutien à la cause palestinienne.
item.dc:creator: Dawoud Abu Alkas, Pesha Magid
item.content:encoded: Une fresque représentant le rappeur américain Macklemore enveloppé dans un drapeau palestinien a été peinte par des artistes gazaouis sur une large dalle de béton au milieu des ruines de l'enclave, afin d'honorer le chanteur pour son soutien à la cause palestinienne. "Merci d'avoir fait entendre ta voix pour la Palestine", peut-on lire sur la fresque représentant Macklemore le poing en l'air. Le rappeur, qui devait effectuer les premières parties des concerts de la pop star britannique Ed Sheeran, a été exclu de la nouvelle tournée de ce dernier pour avoir lancé un appel en faveur d'une "Palestine libre". Critique de longue date des actions militaires israéliennes dans l'enclave palestinienne, Macklemore a été déprogrammé de la tournée d'Ed Sheeran alors que des propriétaires de stades accueillant les concerts ont refusé de le laisser se produire dans leurs enceintes. Le milliardaire américain Robert Kraft, propriétaire du Gillette Stadium dans le Massachusetts, a déclaré avoir interdit à Macklemore de s'y produire en raison de son "antisémitisme". Mais à Gaza, où l'armée israélienne a lancé une campagne militaire à la suite des attaques du Hamas palestinien contre l'Etat hébreu le 7 octobre 2023, la prise de position de l'auteur des hits "Thrift Shop" et "Can't hold us" a été vivement saluée. "Nous voulions envoyer un message pour remercier le rappeur Macklemore de cette manière simple", a déclaré Anne Redwan, 26 ans, qui a conçu et peint la fresque avec son collègue artiste Qusai al-Helo. "En tant qu'artistes vivant sous le siège ici à Gaza, nous attendons le soutien de toute personne capable de voir la persécution à laquelle nous sommes soumis", a-t-elle déclaré à Reuters. "Nous pouvons réaliser des fresques encore plus grandes que celle-ci pour exprimer nos sentiments." Près d'un an après la fin des combats majeurs à Gaza, la reconstruction n'a toujours pas commencé. La plupart des bâtiments ont été détruits et plus de deux millions d'habitants, désormais déplacés et réfugiés dans des abris de fortune, sont confinés sur environ un tiers du territoire de l'enclave. Un plan de paix négocié par les Etats-Unis est au point mort, les négociateurs n'étant pas parvenus à s'entendre sur les conditions du désarmement du Hamas et du retrait des troupes israéliennes. DON D'UN MILLION DE DOLLARS L'exclusion de Macklemore de la tournée d'Ed Sheeran a soulevé une polémique en ligne. Macklemore a déclaré mercredi qu'il ferait don d'un million de dollars de recettes nettes issues du début de la tournée à six organisations humanitaires venant en aide à Gaza. Robert Kraft a quant à lui indiqué qu'Ed Sheeran lui avait confié qu'il ferait don de 2 millions de dollars pour venir en aide dans la région, et lui avait demandé de s'aligner sur cet engagement. Ed Sheeran n'a fait aucun commentaire public concernant d'éventuels dons. Des responsables d'organisations humanitaires ont dit que l'attention de célébrités pourrait contribuer à mobiliser davantage de soutien en faveur de Gaza, où la quasi-totalité des habitants dépend de l'aide humanitaire pour se nourrir, s'approvisionner en eau, bénéficier de soins médicaux et se loger. "Mais ce qui importe vraiment, c'est que les personnes qui se sont montrées si généreuses continuent à s'engager sur le long terme", a déclaré Toby Fricker, un responsable local de l'Unicef. "C'est pourquoi nous appelons vraiment à un soutien durable, non pas à des pics ponctuels, mais à un engagement soutenu." Hussein Murtaja, qui dirige une association humanitaire à Gaza offrant un soutien psychologique aux enfants, a déclaré que la solidarité de Macklemore comptait davantage que l’argent qu’il avait donné. "Lorsque des artistes de cette envergure, qui comptent autant d’abonnés ou de fans, tous viennent à mieux comprendre cette cause et soutiennent la recherche d’une solution politique, soutiennent l’instauration de la paix pour la population de Gaza (...) Cela compte énormément pour nous."

item.title: Trump se reunirá con presidenta encargada de Venezuela en Nueva York el martes
item.description: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, se reunirá el martes en Nueva York con la presidenta encargada de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, según informó el viernes un alto funcionario estadounidense; será el primer encuentro presencial entre ambos líderes desde que Washington destituyó al expresidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro en enero.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, se reunirá el martes en Nueva York con la presidenta encargada de Venezuela, Delcy Rodríguez, según informó el viernes un alto funcionario estadounidense; será el primer encuentro presencial entre ambos líderes desde que Washington destituyó al expresidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro en enero. La reunión de Trump con Rodríguez —exvicepresidenta de Maduro— tendrá lugar al margen de una recepción que ofrecerá el presidente republicano, dijo a los periodistas el embajador de Estados Unidos ante la ONU, Mike Waltz, en una conferencia telefónica informativa. "El presidente ofrecerá una recepción para los líderes de la Asamblea General de la ONU. Allí, mantendrá una breve reunión informal ('pull-aside') con la presidenta encargada de Venezuela, Rodríguez", señaló Waltz. No ofreció detalles sobre los temas que podrían tratar. El Ministerio de Comunicación de Venezuela, encargado de gestionar las consultas de la prensa para el gobierno, no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. El mes pasado, Estados Unidos y Venezuela firmaron un [USN:L6N44T03I TEXT:"acuerdo"] energético que permitiría a Estados Unidos asumir el control parcial de las vastas reservas de petróleo venezolanas, apostando a que las empresas estadounidenses pueden ayudar a reactivar la producción de crudo de la nación sudamericana. La líder opositora venezolana María Corina Machado se enfrenta a un [USN:L6N45713Y TEXT:"dilema"] creciente sobre cuándo regresar al país para recibir apoyos, ante las reticencias de la administración Trump respecto a su retorno. Machado salió del país a finales del año pasado para recibir el Premio Nobel de la Paz, tras haber vivido en la clandestinidad desde las controvertidas elecciones de 2024. Ella había buscado ganarse a Trump como aliado mucho antes de la destitución de Maduro. Sin embargo, desde dicha destitución, Trump ha expresado reiteradamente su apoyo a Rodríguez.

item.title: USA-Trump interdit l'accès à la Maison blanche à CNN, MS NOW et Politico
item.description: Le président américain Donald Trump a interdit vendredi l'accès à la Maison blanche aux chaînes télévisées d'information en continu CNN et MS NOW, ainsi qu'au média en ligne Politico, dénonçant leur couverture journalistique dans un message publié sur les réseaux sociaux.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump a interdit vendredi l'accès à la Maison blanche aux chaînes télévisées d'information en continu CNN et MS NOW, ainsi qu'au média en ligne Politico, dénonçant leur couverture journalistique dans un message publié sur les réseaux sociaux. "A compter de maintenant, j'interdis l'accès à la Maison blanche à 'Fake News CNN', MSNOW (…) et Politico (…), en raison de leurs 'reportages' constants contenant de FAUSSES INFORMATIONS", a écrit Donald Trump sur son réseau Truth Social, ajoutant que d'autres médias se verront infliger le même traitement. "Les médias ne devraient pas pouvoir écrire ou relayer sans cesse des FICTIONS et des MENSONGES lorsqu'ils couvrent l'actualité du président des Etats-Unis, de l'administration Trump ou des Etats-Unis d'Amérique", poursuit Donald Trump. CNN, MS NOW, Politico et le National Press Club n'ont pas répondu dans l'immédiat aux demandes de commentaires. Donald Trump a exhorté à plusieurs reprises les chaînes de télévision à mettre fin aux émissions humoristiques ou d'actualité qu'il n'apprécie pas ou qui ont tourné en dérision ou critiqué sa personne ou son administration. Il a également demandé à la FCC, la Commission fédérale des communications, de retirer leurs licences à des chaînes qui l'ont critiqué.

item.title: Ukraine-Kyiv visée par une attaque de missiles, dit le maire
item.description: Kyiv a subi vendredi soir une attaque de missiles russes, déclaré le maire de la capitale de l'Ukraine, Vitali Klitschko, mais aucune victime ni aucun dégât n'ont été signalés dans l'immédiat.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kyiv a subi vendredi soir une attaque de missiles russes, déclaré le maire de la capitale de l'Ukraine, Vitali Klitschko, mais aucune victime ni aucun dégât n'ont été signalés dans l'immédiat. Vitali Klitschko a déclaré sur la messagerie Telegram que des unités de défense aérienne étaient engagées dans une action contre des missiles russes. Des journalistes de Reuters sur place ont entendu des explosions. Les autorités militaires ont levé l'alerte aérienne après environ 40 minutes. Dans le port d'Odessa, dans le sud de l'Ukraine, le gouverneur régional, Oleh Kiper, a déclaré que les forces russes avaient procédé à deux frappes contre le centre-ville, la seconde alors que les équipes de secours étaient déjà sur place. Il a ajouté que dix personnes avaient été blessées tandis qu'un bâtiment administratif et des véhicules ont été endommagés. Des photos publiées sur Telegram montrent des secours à pied d'oeuvre face à un incendie dans un immeuble de plusieurs étages. Les forces russes ont également attaqué la ville de Balakliia, dans le nord-est de l'Ukraine, faisant deux morts et deux blessés, a déclaré le chef de l'administration militaire de la ville, Vitali Karabanov. S'exprimant sur Telegram, il écrit que l'attaque a provoqué un incendie dans une banlieue de la ville, des résidences privées ayant notamment été endommagées. La ville de Balakliia, située dans la région de Kharkiv, a été conquise par les forces russes dès les premières semaines de l'invasion à grande échelle de l'Ukraine en février 2022, avant d'être reprise par les troupes ukrainiennes lors d'une importante contre-offensive dans le courant de l'année. La Russie et l'Ukraine démentent toutes deux cibler des civils dans ce conflit.

item.title: Retension Pharmaceuticals, TRex Bio file for US IPO as biotech momentum continues
item.description: Drug developers Retension Pharmaceuticals and TRex Bio filed their paperwork for U.S. initial public offerings on Friday, reinforcing the biotech pipeline for the fall IPO window.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Drug developers Retension Pharmaceuticals and TRex Bio filed their paperwork for U.S. initial public offerings on Friday, reinforcing the biotech pipeline for the fall IPO window. The listings would be the latest in a string of biotech IPOs this year, which analysts say has been supported by a wave of acquisitions by large drugmakers. They will also add breadth to the IPO pipeline for the fall window, which has kicked off on a shaky note. "Biotech IPOs tend to be more resistant to the macro headwinds affecting other sectors, like the Iran war or AI disruption," said Matt Kennedy, senior ‍strategist at Renaissance Capital, a provider of IPO-focused research and ETFs. Drug developer Electra Therapeutics (ETRA.O) debuted on Friday after raising $350 million in an upsized U.S. IPO. Its shares closed down 11.7%. Kennedy said biotech IPOs will come under more scrutiny given Electra's decline. "They may no longer get a free pass. But broadly speaking, this sector has been a winner for IPO investors," he added. South San Francisco, California-based TRex is developing medicines to restore immune balance and promote tissue repair in patients with autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Its most advanced product candidate, TRB-061, is being developed in a early-stage clinical trial for a variety of autoimmune and inflammatory diseases. Data from the trial is expected in mid-2027. Drugmaker Eli Lilly (LLY.N) plans to invest in TRex's IPO, according to its prospectus. Separately, Falls Church, Virginia-based Retension is developing medicines to treat hypertension and other cardiovascular diseases. RTN-001, the company's only product candidate, has shown significant reductions in blood pressure in two mid-stage trials. J.P. Morgan, Evercore ISI, Cantor, Stifel and Wedbush PacGrow are the underwriters for TRex's offering. Leerink Partners, Guggenheim Securities, Oppenheimer and Titan Partners are the underwriters for Retension's offering. Retension and TRex will list on the Nasdaq under the symbols "RTSN" and "TRXB", respectively.

item.title: Trump promulgue la loi prévoyant des sanctions contre la Russie
item.description: Le président américain Donald Trump a promulgué vendredi la loi prévoyant d'importantes sanctions contre la Russie, a annoncé la Maison blanche dans un communiqué, ouvrant ainsi la voie à une intensification des pressions économiques sur la Russie.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump a promulgué vendredi la loi prévoyant d'importantes sanctions contre la Russie, a annoncé la Maison blanche dans un communiqué, ouvrant ainsi la voie à une intensification des pressions économiques sur la Russie. Cette législation vise les secteurs de l'énergie et de la défense russes, ainsi que la "flotte fantôme" de pétroliers qui contournent les sanctions existantes, afin de priver Moscou des fonds nécessaires au financement de sa guerre contre l'Ukraine. Les détracteurs de cette loi, qui impose également des droits de douane aux principaux partenaires commerciaux de la Russie, estiment qu'elle pourrait causer des problèmes à d'autres pays s'ils se retrouvaient dans le collimateur de Donald Trump à l'avenir, car elle autorise également le président à imposer des droits de douane qui pourraient perdurer bien au-delà de son mandat. Le projet de loi, désormais rebaptisé "Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026" en hommage au sénateur républicain de Caroline du Sud décédé en juillet, a été adopté mercredi par la Chambre des représentants après avoir été approuvé le mois dernier par le Sénat. Lindsey Graham, l'un des plus farouches défenseurs de l'Ukraine au Capitole, soutenait de longue date cette législation.

item.title: Trump affirme que les Etats-Unis, le Danemark et le Groenland ont conclu un accord sur l'île
item.description: Le président américain Donald Trump a déclaré vendredi que Washington avait conclu un accord avec le Danemark et le Groenland qui donne aux Etats-Unis un contrôle permanent sur la sécurité et tous les autres besoins de l'île.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery, Erin Banco, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen, Stine Jacobsen
item.content:encoded: Le président américain Donald Trump a déclaré vendredi que Washington avait conclu un accord avec le Danemark et le Groenland qui donne aux Etats-Unis un contrôle permanent sur la sécurité et tous les autres besoins de l'île. Cette déclaration intervient quelques minutes après que deux sources proches du dossier ont rapporté à Reuters que les Etats-Unis et le Danemark étaient sur le point de conclure un accord concernant le statut du Groenland, qui permettrait à l'armée américaine de renforcer sa présence sur l'île. Si cet accord voyait le jour, il serait toutefois en deçà de l'objectif initial du président américain, Donald Trump, qui souhaitait purement et simplement acquérir le Groenland, avaient précisé les sources, sous couvert d'anonymat. Il pourrait néanmoins se traduire par une présence américaine plus marquée sur un territoire qui concentre l'attention du locataire de la Maison blanche depuis près de dix ans, avaient-elles ajouté. Les parties concernées ont discuté de dispositions visant à garantir que le territoire groenlandais puisse être utilisé pour le "Golden Dome", le projet de gigantesque bouclier antimissile que l'administration Trump tente de mettre en place pour protéger le territoire américain, avaient expliqué les sources. L'une d'elles avait souligné que les discussions portaient également sur des dispositions visant à limiter la présence et l'influence de la Chine sur l'île.

item.title: Gemini hacked three companies in first known breakout by Google's AI
item.description: Google's Gemini model accessed the internet and hacked other companies during a test of its cybersecurity capabilities, the first known example of the company's AI systems autonomously committing such an act.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Google's (GOOGL.O) Gemini model accessed the internet and hacked other companies during a test of its cybersecurity capabilities, the first known example of the company's AI systems autonomously committing such an act. The hacks occurred in May during a cybersecurity test conducted by Irregular, an independent company that conducts cybersecurity evaluations. During a standard testing evaluation, Gemini found public information online and guessed credentials to access three websites it thought were within the scope of its test, Heather Adkins, Google's vice president of security engineering, said in a statement. "We ensured the three entities were made aware, and we worked with our training partner on the changes they’ve now made to their testing processes," Adkins said. "These events highlight the importance of training powerful AI models to act responsibly." An Irregular spokesperson said the incident involved the same issue that affected other AI labs and that all relevant labs were notified in late July. "All known issues on our end were remedied and resolved weeks ago," the spokesperson said. Similar incidents linked to Irregular were disclosed by Meta, Anthropic and OpenAI. Meta said in August [USN:L6N4421DM TEXT:"the incident"] did not involve a sandbox escape or sophisticated cyberattack, while Irregular said it was working on best practices for securely conducting AI cybersecurity evaluations. The incidents have raised questions about the safeguards needed as AI agents gain greater autonomy and access to the internet and computer systems. In one of the cases, the Gemini model guessed passwords until it gained access to a protected system. In the other two cases, the model found credentials in a public repository that allowed it to then access protected systems, according to the Wall Street Journal, which first reported the news on Friday. Adkins said that in all three instances, the model ceased its hacking.

item.title: Alonso's Chelsea honeymoon shattered by 3-0 loss at Brentford
item.description: Chelsea coach Xabi Alonso will be relieved that the international break now gives him three weeks of respite to fix his team who, after a 3-0 defeat at Brentford on Friday, have conceded 12 goals in their five opening Premier League games.
item.dc:creator: William Schomberg
item.content:encoded: Chelsea coach Xabi Alonso will be relieved that the international break now gives him three weeks of respite to fix his team who, after a 3-0 defeat at Brentford on Friday, have conceded 12 goals in their five opening Premier League games. The season began brightly with wins over Fulham and Brighton & Hove Albion, prompting talk of Alonso turning Chelsea into possible title contenders after his move to Stamford Bridge in July. But there were warning signs in those early wins as Chelsea let in five goals over the 180 minutes. A subsequent 2-1 defeat at Arsenal, a 2-2 home draw against Hull City last weekend and Friday's hammering by Brentford have ruined Alonso's honeymoon. The Spaniard said his players were proving unable to keep their focus throughout matches and needed to show more consistency and fighting mentality. "It's about 95 minutes. We have not been able to keep that level throughout these few games in the start of the season, and it's something that we have to do better," Alonso told reporters. "We know that it's a process, that it's still (only) five games, and in a competitive Premier League, that each game is really hard." Alonso will be hoping for good news from his medical team before Chelsea's next game, at home against Bournemouth on October 10. Midfield lynchpin Moises Caicedo, who typically provides a screen for the defence, has played only 14 minutes so far this season and Italy defender Marco Palestra has not featured at all since he moved to London over the summer. In-form Brazil striker Joao Pedro was conspicuous by his absence on Friday. But Chelsea fans will be wondering how the other members of their expensively assembled team were largely outplayed by Brentford in the second half of Friday's encounter after a goalless first half. Goals from Jaidon Anthony, Igor Thiago and substitute Fabio Carvalho showed how the Bees have gone from strength to strength since Keith Andrews took over as coach in 2025 and they are unbeaten so far this campaign. "I felt there was a performance bubbling. I just could see that in the players’ eyes last couple of days," Andrews told reporters. "The approach has been really focused and I thought in the second half in particular we showed exactly what we are."

item.title: Yankees to place Aaron Judge (calf) on 10-day IL
item.description: The New York Yankees said Friday that they will place outfielder Aaron Judge on the 10-day injured list Saturday due to a right calf strain.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New York Yankees said Friday that they will place outfielder Aaron Judge on the 10-day injured list Saturday due to a right calf strain. A corresponding roster move will be announced at that time, per the team. The Yankees' captain and three-time American League MVP was removed from Wednesday's game at the Minnesota Twins after the sixth inning due to tightness in his lower right leg. He told reporters afterward that he felt it during the first inning and "tried to play it off" before reporting it to manager Aaron Boone. Judge, 34, missed more than three months of the season due to a rib injury and only returned on Sept. 8. "Once you start ramping up, things pop up," Judge said. "Hopefully, it's just one little thing and we're back out there soon." The Yankees had Thursday off and begin a three-game series at the Arizona Diamondbacks on Friday night. Because the IL move is likely to be backdated to Thursday, Judge would be eligible for activation on Sept. 27, the final day of the regular season. The Yankees (88-64) are five games behind the Tampa Bay Rays (93-59) in the AL East race. Those teams have the two best records in the AL and will play a four-game series in New York next week. Judge has appeared in just 66 games this season, batting .241 with 18 home runs and 41 RBIs. In his seven games back from his last IL stint, he was just 4-for-23 (.174) with one homer and three RBIs. --Field Level Media

item.title: Milho e soja caem em Chicago por realização de lucros
item.description: Os contratos futuros do milho e soja dos EUA caíram nesta sexta-feira, à medida que os operadores realizavam lucros após as recentes máximas em vários anos, os preços do petróleo recuavam e a colheita avançava no Meio-Oeste, apesar das chuvas esporádicas, segundo analistas.
item.dc:creator: Julie Ingwersen
item.content:encoded: Os contratos futuros do milho e soja dos EUA caíram nesta sexta-feira, à medida que os operadores realizavam lucros após as recentes máximas em vários anos, os preços do petróleo recuavam e a colheita avançava no Meio-Oeste, apesar das chuvas esporádicas, segundo analistas. A atenção voltava-se para a reunião da próxima semana entre os presidentes Donald Trump e Xi Jinping, na qual as compras chinesas de soja e outros produtos agrícolas dos EUA estarão entre os temas comerciais em destaque. O trigo recuou devido a vendas técnicas e às esperanças persistentes de uma distensão na zona de exportação do Mar Negro. O contrato de soja na bolsa de Chicago fechou em queda de 16,25 centavos, ou 1,2%, a US$13,035 por bushel. O contrato de milho encerrou em queda de 3 centavos, ou 0,6%, a US$5,275 por bushel, após atingir a mínima de uma semana em US$5,255. O contrato de trigo fechou em queda de 12,75 centavos, ou 1,8%, a US$7,1425 por bushel.

item.title: Trump signs Russia sanctions bill into law
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Friday signed the sweeping Russia sanctions bill into law, the White House said in a statement, paving the way for increased economic pressure on Russia over its invasion of Ukraine.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Friday signed the sweeping Russia sanctions bill into law, the White House said in a statement, paving the way for increased economic pressure on Russia over its invasion of Ukraine. The legislation targets Russia's energy and defense industries, as well as its "shadow fleet" of tankers that evade existing sanctions, in order to deprive Moscow of funds used to pay for its war with Ukraine. Critics say the legislation, which also levies tariffs on Russia's biggest trading partners, could herald trouble for other countries as well if they find themselves in Trump's crosshairs in the future because it [USN:L1N4590XN TEXT:"also authorizes"] the president to impose tariffs that could last well beyond his presidency. The bill, now called the "Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026," to honor the South Carolina Republican [USN:L6N43E02O TEXT:"who died"] in July, passed the House of Representatives on Wednesday and the Senate last month. Graham, a longtime Russia hawk, was a staunch backer of the legislation.

item.title: Seoul affirms US investment pledges, intent to help with Strait of Hormuz free passage
item.description: South Korea reaffirmed its willingness to make a substantive contribution to restoring free passage through the Middle East's Strait of Hormuz, one of a number of issues discussed by Foreign Minister Cho Hyun during Friday talks in Washington with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, the ministry said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korea reaffirmed its willingness to make a substantive contribution to restoring free passage through the Middle East's Strait of Hormuz, one of a number of issues discussed by Foreign Minister Cho Hyun during Friday talks in Washington with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, the ministry said on Saturday. Cho had travelled to Washington this week for talks with Rubio and members of US Congress. The State Department and South Korea's foreign ministry said they would push to ensure the swift execution of South Korea's investment commitments in the United States. The allies have continued negotiations on implementing a trade agreement struck last year that included $350 billion in South Korean investments in US manufacturing in return for lowering tariffs on Korean imports to 15%. The two sides agreed to keep working towards denuclearisation on the Korean Peninsula through diplomacy, Seoul's ministry said, with Cho vowing to support talks between Washington and nuclear-armed North Korea. Rubio and Cho reinforced the importance of trilateral cooperation between the US, Japan and South Korea in safeguarding regional security, a State Department spokesperson said.

item.title: Morgan Stanley private credit fund redemption requests remain elevated in third quarter
item.description: Withdrawal requests at a Morgan Stanley private credit fund remained elevated in the third-quarter repurchase offer, according to a regulatory filing on Friday, as the investment vehicle works through its redemption queue.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Withdrawal requests at a Morgan Stanley (MS.N) private credit fund remained elevated in the third-quarter repurchase offer, according to a regulatory filing on Friday, as the investment vehicle works through its redemption queue. Investors in Morgan Stanley's North Haven Private Income Fund (PIF) sought to withdraw 11.4% of shares in the latest tender offer, a slight dip from the 11.6% in the prior quarter. The fund will repurchase 5% of shares, the customary threshold for such vehicles. Wealthy investors have pulled money from non-traded private credit funds in recent months over concerns regarding lending standards and whether software companies, a key borrower base for direct lenders, can withstand disruption from artificial intelligence. Redemption pressure, however, may be [USN:L4N4530XC TEXT:"starting to ease"] as asset managers work through a backlog of unfulfilled withdrawal requests. The fund said nearly two-thirds of repurchase requests for the latest quarter came from investors who were not allowed to fully cash out in the prior two repurchase offers. "We believe the composition and stabilization of request activity may indicate the durability of the company's investor base. Upon completion of this quarter's repurchases, investors who sought full tender of their units during the prior two repurchase offers will have received more than 80% of their requested tendered amount," the fund said in an investor update. The hit to PIF's net asset value is expected to be roughly $101 million after accounting for new subscriptions and dividend reinvestments. Meanwhile, a smaller Morgan Stanley fund, North Haven Private Income Fund A (PIF A), logged about 6.8% in redemption requests, compared with 7.2% in the prior quarter. This fund will also repurchase 5% of shares. Data from major private credit vehicles run by Apollo (APO.N) , Ares (ARES.N) and Blue Owl (OWL.N) is expected to be unveiled in the coming weeks.

item.title: Oracle's $18 billion data center debt under pressure, FT reports
item.description: About $18 billion in loans tied to an Oracle-leased data center in New Mexico has come under pressure, with loans quoted at 89 to 91 cents on the dollar by syndicate banks including Santander and Jefferies , the Financial Times reported on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: About $18 billion in loans tied to an Oracle-leased (ORCL.N) data center in New Mexico has come under pressure, with loans quoted at 89 to 91 cents on the dollar by syndicate banks including Santander and Jefferies (JEF.N) , the Financial Times reported on Friday. The development comes amid concerns that growing local opposition to the project over fears it would impact water supply and air quality could derail Oracle's massive AI infrastructure build-out, the FT report said. The 1,400-acre "Project Jupiter" campus in Doña Ana County is part of Oracle's broader agreement with OpenAI to provide AI computing capacity. The project [USN:L4N3WJ1RZ TEXT:"secured"] $18 billion in loans from a consortium of banks late last year to kick-start construction, according to media reports. Efforts to sell the debt to a broader pool of investors have stalled amid concerns over Oracle's rising borrowing and weakening creditworthiness, the Financial Times said. Oracle, Santander and Jefferies did not respond to Reuters requests for comment. Oracle's corporate credit rating sits one notch above junk following a downgrade from S&P in July. Banks were now forced to hold more Oracle-linked project debt on their balance sheets than initially planed, the Financial Times said. Oracle has been ramping up spending to finance its expansion into AI infrastructure, while its rising debt load has drawn increasing investor scrutiny. Project Jupiter was initially set to be powered by 2.2 gigawatts of gas turbines, but the state land office blocked a request to run a natural gas pipeline to the data center, the report said.

item.title: Trump extends push for $100,000 H-1B visas by another year
item.description: President Donald Trump has extended an executive order that would impose a fee of $100,000 for H-1B non-immigrant visas by another year, the White House said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump has extended an executive order that would impose a fee of $100,000 for [USN:L1N44M0MZ TEXT:"H-1B non-immigrant"] visas by another year, the White House said on Friday. US employers seeking to hire skilled foreign workers can use the federal government's H-1B visa program for a fee, allowing tech and other professionals from abroad to work in the United States for a few years. Trump, who has pursued an aggressive immigration crackdown, has criticized the program and wants to permanently raise the fee from between $2,000 and $5,000 to at least $100,000, though the attempt has faced legal challenges. A Boston-based appeals court [USN:L6N43Q1BA TEXT:"is reviewing"] a June decision by a federal judge who deemed the higher fee imposed by the Trump administration illegal and blocked the government from collecting it. Another court is considering whether a judge properly rejected a challenge to the fee by the US Chamber of Commerce, the largest US business lobbying group. Trump's initial [USN:L1N44H0LJ TEXT:"order"] for a fee hike, first released in September 2025, was set to expire this month. It did not apply to visas granted to foreign citizens already in the United States on student visas, who make up a large share of new H-1B recipients, or to renewals of current visas. Despite criticism that some companies use the visas to hire lower-paid foreign workers instead of Americans, business groups and companies say they help recruit highly skilled professionals and address a lack of qualified US workers in some industries. The visas, established by Congress in 1990, are especially critical for tech companies seeking to recruit from India and China. Changes to how potential visa holders are scrutinized and processed have impacted companies' hiring and expansion plans, with some top H-1B users, such as Google parent company Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , moving to increase operations in India.

item.title: Turkey revokes operating license of Iran's Mellat Bank amid US measures
item.description: Turkey's BDDK banking watchdog revoked the operating license of Iranian lender Mellat Bank's branch in Istanbul, according to a notice published in the Official Gazette on Saturday, as the US presses other countries to increase economic pressure on Tehran.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Turkey's BDDK banking watchdog revoked the operating license of Iranian lender Mellat Bank's branch in Istanbul, according to a notice published in the Official Gazette on Saturday, as the US presses other countries to increase economic pressure on Tehran. "It has been decided to revoke the operating license of Bank Mellat, Head Office in Tehran, Istanbul Turkey Central Branch," the notice said, without citing the US measures or any operational issues. It said the decision was taken under a clause of Turkey's banking law, which allows a bank's license to be revoked or withdrawn if its continued operation is deemed to pose a risk to depositors' rights or the security and stability of the financial system. Earlier this month, the US Treasury Department [USN:L1N44W0I7 TEXT:"imposed sanctions"] on a small Turkish investment bank and two subsidiaries. The Treasury also said Turkey and Oman had decided to [USN:L1N4500LT TEXT:"stop flights"] by Iranian airlines Mahan Air to their countries as a result of discussions held with both countries on complying with US measures against Iran.

item.title: Suprema Corte de México no prohibió que aspirante a gobierno de Michoacán use sombrero
item.description: La Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación de México (SCJN) no le prohibió usar sombrero a Grecia Quiroz, presidenta municipal interina de Uruapan, Michoacán, y aspirante a la gubernatura del estado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: La Suprema Corte de Justicia de la Nación de México (SCJN) no le prohibió usar sombrero a Grecia Quiroz, presidenta municipal interina de Uruapan, Michoacán, y aspirante a la gubernatura del estado. Publicaciones en redes sociales dicen que la Corte validó disposiciones en una reforma al Código Electoral estatal que impiden a Quiroz portar un sombrero, el símbolo del denominado “Movimiento Independiente del Sombrero”, impulsado por su esposo, [USN:L1N3WW00G TEXT:"Carlos Manzo"], quien fue asesinado el 1 de noviembre de [USN:L1N3WH114 TEXT:"2025"]. Sin embargo, el pleno de la Corte no se refirió específicamente a Quiroz ni al uso de su sombrero, sino que abordó disposiciones generales sobre el empleo de recursos visuales y narrativos en las campañas. “La resolución no establece una prohibición específica para que las candidaturas independientes utilicen una prenda, como un sombrero”, dijo Amanda Pérez, directora general de Comunicación Social de la SCJN, a Reuters en un correo el 9 de septiembre. El 27 de agosto la Corte resolvió una acción de inconstitucionalidad del partido Movimiento Ciudadano en contra de las reformas al Código Electoral de Michoacán del 27 de mayo , por considerar que vulneraban los derechos de candidaturas independientes. Dicha reforma establecía que las candidaturas independientes recibirán una sanción si usan colores, símbolos, emblemas, logotipos o imágenes que generen en los votantes “la percepción de pertenencia” a una misma organización. La Corte invalidó estos conceptos al considerar que no ofrecen parámetros claros para determinar cuándo existe una infracción. Sin embargo, la SCJN validó los artículos que establecen que las candidaturas independientes deberán abstenerse de usar en su propaganda cualquier elemento vinculado a una marca registrada. El Instituto Mexicano de la Propiedad Industrial otorgó el 8 de enero el registro de la marca con fines políticos “Movimiento Independiente del Sombrero” a Quiroz. Al respecto, Pérez dijo que, de acuerdo con la discusión en el Pleno, esta disposición no se puede interpretar al punto de impedir que la persona titular de los derechos pueda utilizarla para los fines con los que fue registrada. “Una cuestión distinta sería su utilización por terceras candidaturas, supuesto que tendría que analizarse conforme a las reglas que impiden formas de asociación o coordinación electoral incompatibles con la naturaleza de las candidaturas independientes”, añadió. El 28 de agosto, Quiroz, quien ha expresado su intención de ser gobernadora de Michoacán, publicó en su página de Facebook que la resolución de la SCJN representa “un avance importante para las candidaturas independientes” respecto a lo invalidado en la reforma electoral. Sin embargo, añadió que todavía permanecen disposiciones que considera “excesivas y restrictivas” y seguiría defendiendo el uso del sombrero como una identidad. Pérez concluyó que para que el uso de un sombrero sea una infracción electoral, “tendría que actualizarse alguna de las conductas expresamente previstas por la ley, como una coordinación real entre distintas candidaturas independientes o un supuesto relacionado con el uso de una marca protegida en propaganda electoral”. El Gobierno de Uruapan y el equipo de trabajo de Quiroz no respondieron a una solicitud de comentarios. VEREDICTO Falta contexto. La sentencia de la SCJN sobre la reforma electoral en Michoacán no prohíbe a Grecia Quiroz el uso de sombrero. item.title: Petróleo cai após China pedir ao Irã que limite ataques dos houthis a instalações da Arábia Saudita
item.description: Os preços do petróleo caíram nesta sexta-feira depois que a China, atendendo a um pedido da Arábia Saudita, solicitou ao Irã que limitasse os ataques dos rebeldes houthis à infraestrutura petrolífera saudita, que têm ameaçado uma segunda rota de exportação de petróleo no Oriente Médio.
item.dc:creator: Seher Dareen
item.content:encoded: Os preços do petróleo caíram nesta sexta-feira depois que a China, atendendo a um pedido da Arábia Saudita, solicitou ao Irã que limitasse os ataques dos rebeldes houthis à infraestrutura petrolífera saudita, que têm ameaçado uma segunda rota de exportação de petróleo no Oriente Médio. Os contratos futuros do petróleo Brent fecharam a US$104,87 o barril, com queda de 95 centavos, ou 0,93%. Os contratos futuros do West Texas Intermediate (WTI) dos Estados Unidos fecharam a US$100,30 o barril, com queda de US$1,61, ou 1,58%. Os preços do petróleo têm subido de forma constante nas últimas semanas, à medida que os EUA e o Irã retomaram os ataques mútuos e os houthis, aliados do Irã, também intensificaram suas atividades militares. Essas ações recentes, aliadas a problemas de capacidade de refino em todo o mundo, elevaram o preço de combustíveis essenciais, como o diesel, nos principais mercados. Atualmente, o diesel no varejo nos Estados Unidos custa US$6,45 por galão, segundo dados da AAA, um recorde, enquanto a gasolina no varejo custa, em média, US$4,47 por galão, numa época do ano em que os preços da gasolina costumam cair. A IIR Energy, provedora de dados sobre refino, informou nesta sexta-feira que a capacidade de refino em operação nos EUA deve cair na próxima semana em 371 mil barris por dia (bpd). “No momento, não é um problema de oferta; é um problema de refino”, disse Phil Flynn, analista sênior do Price Futures Group.

item.title: Nationals lock up RHP Cade Cavalli with 4-year extension
item.description: The Washington Nationals agreed to a four-year contract extension plus a club option for 2031 with right-hander Cade Cavalli on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Washington Nationals agreed to a four-year contract extension plus a club option for 2031 with right-hander Cade Cavalli on Friday. Reports pegged the worth as $47 million. The deal would grow to $70 million over five seasons if the Nationals pick up the option. "We are thrilled that Cade and his family will remain part of the Washington Nationals for years to come," managing principal owner Mark D. Lerner said in a statement. "Since we drafted Cade in 2020, we've been continually impressed with who he is as a baseball player and as a human being. He's shown that he not only has the talent to excel as a Major Leaguer, but he also possesses the high character and leadership qualities that make him a beloved member of our clubhouse and in the community." Cavalli, 28, is enjoying a breakthrough season after dealing with arm injuries over the previous three seasons. He had Tommy John surgery in March 2023 and missed two full campaigns before making 10 starts late in 2025. This season, Cavalli has made 31 starts and is 12-5 with a 3.12 ERA. He ranks fourth in the National League with 194 strikeouts and has a 1.17 WHIP in 164 2/3 innings. In 42 career starts for Washington, Cavalli is 15-7 with a 3.60 ERA. He made one start in August 2022 before not taking the mound again for more than 35 months. Cavalli is slated to start Friday night's game against the host St. Louis Cardinals. --Field Level Media

item.title: EEUU y Dinamarca llegan a un acuerdo sobre Groenlandia, dice Trump
item.description: Estados Unidos, Dinamarca y Groenlandia firmaron un acuerdo por el que Estados Unidos tendrá una importante presencia militar en la isla, y que prohíbe a los adversarios de Washington construir allí sus propias bases, dijo Donald Trump el viernes.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery, Erin Banco, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen, Stine Jacobsen
item.content:encoded: Estados Unidos, Dinamarca y Groenlandia firmaron un acuerdo por el que Estados Unidos tendrá una importante presencia militar en la isla, y que prohíbe a los adversarios de Washington construir allí sus propias bases, dijo Donald Trump el viernes. En una publicación en Truth Social, el presidente de Estados Unidos escribió que ningún enemigo de Washington podría realizar inversiones sensibles en la isla sin la aprobación de Estados Unidos y que el acuerdo no tenía fecha de caducidad. "Bajo mi dirección, hemos colaborado con representantes de Dinamarca y Groenlandia para garantizar que Estados Unidos tenga PARA SIEMPRE plena capacidad para hacer lo que sea necesario en Groenlandia con el fin de garantizar y defender la seguridad de Groenlandia y de los Estados Unidos de América", escribió Trump. "Además, a partir de ahora, ningún adversario de Estados Unidos podrá JAMÁS tener una base en Groenlandia, mantener una presencia militar en Groenlandia ni realizar inversiones sensibles en Groenlandia sin nuestra aprobación expresa por escrito". El viernes por la mañana, Reuters informó en exclusiva de que Estados Unidos y Groenlandia estaban a punto de cerrar un acuerdo sobre la isla que supondría un aumento de la presencia militar estadounidense, pero que se quedaría muy lejos del sueño que Trump acariciaba desde hacía tiempo: adquirir la isla para Estados Unidos.

item.title: Former Vitol oil trader sentenced to four years in US prison over Ecuador and Mexico bribery
item.description: A former oil trader at Vitol, one of the world's largest energy trading companies, was sentenced on Friday to four years in prison in the U.S. over his 2024 conviction on corruption charges stemming from more than $1 million in bribes he paid to officials in Ecuador and Mexico to win business.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen
item.content:encoded: A former oil trader at [USN:L1N3DE23W TEXT:"Vitol"], one of the world's largest energy trading companies, was sentenced on Friday to four years in prison in the U.S. over his 2024 conviction on corruption charges stemming from more than $1 million in bribes he paid to officials in Ecuador and Mexico to win business. Javier Aguilar was [USN:L2N3F8339 TEXT:"found guilty"] at trial on three counts of foreign bribery, foreign bribery conspiracy, and money laundering conspiracy. U.S. District Judge Eric Vitaliano handed down the sentence at a hearing in Brooklyn federal court. Aguilar's case was part of a sprawling Justice Department probe into commodity trading firms paying bribes to win business from state-run companies across Latin America. Vitol in December 2020 admitted to bribing officials in Brazil, Mexico and Ecuador and [USN:L1N2IJ1UL TEXT:"paid $164 million"] to resolve U.S. and Brazilian probes. Rival trader Gunvor in 2024 agreed to pay about [USN:L2N3FF1ZS TEXT:"$662 million"] to resolve U.S. and Swiss investigations into a scheme to pay bribes to Ecuadorean officials to win business. Prosecutors with the Brooklyn U.S. Attorney's office said Vitol obtained and retained more than $500 million worth of business with Mexican and Ecuadorean state oil companies due to bribes Aguilar paid between 2015 and 2020. The prosecutors sought a 12-year prison sentence, arguing a stiff punishment was needed to deter others. Aguilar's defense lawyers had urged Vitaliano to spare their client prison time. They said he was "ashamed" of his conduct, had pleaded guilty in a related case brought in Houston federal court and had agreed to forfeit $7 million. He also faces deportation to Mexico regardless of his sentence.

item.title: Brazil industrial maintenance and assembly workers strike at oil platforms, union says
item.description: Brazilian workers in Rio de Janeiro's industrial maintenance and assembly sectors have begun a strike that includes employees at oil platforms, local union SINTPICC-RJ said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian workers in Rio de Janeiro's industrial maintenance and assembly sectors have begun a strike that includes employees at oil platforms, local union SINTPICC-RJ said on Friday. Brazil's state-run oil firm Petrobras (PETR3.SA) has said its oil platforms continue to produce normally, and that it is following negotiations between its contractors and the striking workers. Workers are striking over a deadlock in labor negotiations with employers, the union said in a statement. According to the union, strikes at oil platforms do not necessarily affect production.

item.title: Trump diz que vai exigir que algumas vacinas infantis sejam divididas em cinco doses
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que seu governo planeja exigir que os fabricantes de vacinas dividam certas vacinas infantis em cinco doses separadas, o que, segundo ele, resultará em uma redução maciça do autismo — uma ideia repetidamente refutada por cientistas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que seu governo planeja exigir que os fabricantes de vacinas dividam certas vacinas infantis em cinco doses separadas, o que, segundo ele, resultará em uma redução maciça do autismo — uma ideia repetidamente refutada por cientistas. Trump não apresentou nenhuma evidência científica que relacione vacinas e autismo. Tampouco especificou quais vacinas o governo planeja dividir em doses menores. “Vamos recomendar que sejam aplicadas cinco doses... e que sejam administradas em intervalos de seis meses, para que uma pequena quantidade da vacina seja injetada no corpo”, disse Trump, falando em um evento no Salão Oval. Trump já havia assinado, em agosto, um decreto exigindo a redução do número de vacinas infantis, limitando o calendário de vacinação a 11 imunizações — o que, segundo ele, daria às crianças norte-americanas proteção “padrão-ouro” e alinharia o país a nações semelhantes que recomendam menos doses. Esse decreto determinava que os norte-americanos recebessem vacinas separadas contra sarampo, caxumba e rubéola, embora nenhuma dessas vacinas individuais seja licenciada nos Estados Unidos e especialistas afirmem que pode levar anos até que alguma delas se torne disponível, se é que isso algum dia acontecerá. O decreto promove um objetivo de longa data do secretário de Saúde, Robert F. Kennedy Jr., um ativista antivacina que vem promovendo uma suposta ligação entre vacinas e autismo — algo que os cientistas já refutaram repetidamente.

item.title: North Korea says nuclear status 'irreversible' after UN atomic agency rebuke
item.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's powerful sister, Kim Yo Jong, accused the International Atomic Energy Agency on Saturday of double standards after it adopted a resolution criticising Pyongyang's nuclear weapons programme.
item.dc:creator: Joyce Lee
item.content:encoded: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un's powerful sister, Kim Yo Jong, accused the International Atomic Energy Agency on Saturday of double standards after it adopted a resolution criticising Pyongyang's nuclear weapons programme. The IAEA's "biased viewpoint and double standards" are "the fundamental factor causing the collapse of the international nuclear non-proliferation system", Kim Yo Jong said in a statement in state media KCNA. She said the agency had turned a blind eye to the "blatant nuclear proliferation activities" of the United States and South Korea's "nuclear submarine introduction plan", while forcibly adopting a resolution against North Korea's "self-defensive and legitimate nuclear activities". In a separate KCNA statement, North Korea's Foreign Ministry also dismissed the resolution, declaring that its status as a nuclear power is irreversible and backed by its nuclear deterrent. KCNA also said North Korean leader Kim Jong Un carried out a three-day inspection tour of major munitions factories this week. Kim said North Korea's efforts to modernise all components of its defence capability are bringing about "a significant change" in the composition and means of its armed forces, KCNA said. Analysts say North Korea has been overhauling its military with Russian help since the two countries signed a mutual defence treaty in 2024. They say combat experience gained by Pyongyang's troops deployed to the war in Ukraine has also aided the effort. Kim also gave a lecture to a propaganda workers' training session in Pyongyang on Friday, KCNA reported, telling attendees modern "ideological warfare" needed to be innovative, creative and aggressive rather than repeating old methods.

item.title: La seguridad alimentaria de Centroamérica se ve amenazada por El Niño, según el IRC
item.description: El fenómeno meteorológico histórico conocido como "super El Niño", cuyo punto álgido se prevé entre noviembre de 2026 y enero de 2027, amenaza con deteriorar rápidamente la seguridad alimentaria en Honduras, Guatemala y El Salvador, según la organización humanitaria Comité Internacional de Rescate (IRC).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El fenómeno meteorológico histórico conocido como "super El Niño", cuyo punto álgido se prevé entre noviembre de 2026 y enero de 2027, amenaza con deteriorar rápidamente la seguridad alimentaria en Honduras, Guatemala y El Salvador, según la organización humanitaria Comité Internacional de Rescate (IRC). Las interrupciones en el transporte marítimo provocadas por los conflictos están provocando un aumento de los precios de los alimentos, el combustible y los fertilizantes, agregó. El IRC advirtió de que la "escasez de lluvias" podría provocar sequías y hacer que 700.000 personas en El Salvador se vean en situación de necesidad inmediata de ayuda de emergencia. En Panamá, JP Morgan prevé que El Niño obligue a imponer nuevas restricciones al tráfico marítimo por el Canal de Panamá durante el cuarto trimestre del año, y la Autoridad del Canal prevé un descenso del 5% en los tránsitos en 2027. El fenómeno meteorológico de El Niño consiste en un calentamiento periódico de las temperaturas de la superficie del mar en el Pacífico oriental, provocado por el debilitamiento de los vientos alisios. Ocurre cada dos a siete años, suele durar hasta 12 meses y puede afectar a los patrones de precipitaciones y temperaturas en todas las regiones. La sequía provocada por El Niño ha devastado las cosechas de maíz y frijoles en todo el Corredor Seco de América Central, lo que ha sumido a decenas de miles de hogares rurales en una mayor inseguridad alimentaria e hídrica, ha dicho Oxfam.

item.title: EUA e Dinamarca chegam a acordo sobre Groenlândia, diz Trump
item.description: Estados Unidos, Dinamarca e Groenlândia firmaram um acordo para que os EUA estabeleçam uma presença militar significativa na Groenlândia, ao mesmo tempo em que proíbem os adversários dos EUA de construir suas próprias bases na ilha, afirmou Donald Trump nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery, Erin Banco, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen, Stine Jacobsen
item.content:encoded: Estados Unidos, Dinamarca e Groenlândia firmaram um acordo para que os EUA estabeleçam uma presença militar significativa na Groenlândia, ao mesmo tempo em que proíbem os adversários dos EUA de construir suas próprias bases na ilha, afirmou Donald Trump nesta sexta-feira. Em uma postagem no Truth Social, o presidente dos EUA escreveu que nenhum inimigo dos EUA poderia realizar investimentos sensíveis na ilha sem a aprovação dos Estados Unidos e que o acordo não tem prazo de validade. “Sob minha orientação, trabalhamos com representantes da Dinamarca e da Groenlândia para garantir que os Estados Unidos tenham PARA SEMPRE total capacidade de fazer o que for necessário na Groenlândia a fim de assegurar e defender a segurança da Groenlândia e dos Estados Unidos da América”, escreveu Trump. Na manhã desta sexta-feira, a Reuters noticiou com exclusividade que os EUA e a Groenlândia estavam prestes a fechar um acordo que resultaria em maior presença militar norte-americana, mas que ficaria bem aquém do sonho de longa data de Trump de adquirir a ilha para os Estados Unidos. O anúncio de Trump nesta sexta-feira sugere que ele, mesmo assim, ficou satisfeito com o resultado das negociações e que talvez não retome suas reivindicações territoriais, pelo menos no futuro próximo. Ele afirmou, sem dar mais detalhes, que os EUA em breve implantariam uma grande presença militar na ilha, que já abriga uma base da Força Espacial em seu remoto noroeste. “Este é um sonho que se tornou realidade para os Estados Unidos da América”, escreveu Trump. O gabinete da primeira-ministra dinamarquesa afirmou nesta sexta-feira que o acordo fortaleceria a segurança do Atlântico Norte e do Ártico. RUBIO DIZ QUE ACORDO ABORDA PREOCUPAÇÕES DE SEGURANÇA Muitas coisas ainda não estavam claras na noite desta sexta-feira, incluindo se novas bases norte-americanas seriam construídas como resultado do acordo. As publicações de Trump no Truth Social sobre negociações ou acordos muitas vezes carecem de contexto ou detalhes. Os EUA já possuem direitos quase totais de sobrevoo e instalação de bases na Groenlândia devido a um tratado de 1951. Também não estava claro como o acordo seria recebido na Groenlândia, um território autônomo da Dinamarca. Os moradores da ilha aspiram à independência e têm se mostrado irritados com as tentativas dos EUA de afirmar sua hegemonia. Em uma declaração separada, o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, afirmou que o acordo abordava “de forma permanente e completa” as preocupações de Washington com a segurança nacional no que diz respeito à ilha. “A Groenlândia fará parte para sempre da área de defesa estratégica da América do Norte e excluirá qualquer adversário dela e da região circundante”, escreveu ele. Uma autoridade do Departamento de Estado, falando sob condição de anonimato para discutir termos específicos, disse que o acordo proíbe países não pertencentes à Otan de construir uma base na Groenlândia e permitirá apenas que os EUA e seus aliados realizem “investimentos sensíveis” não especificados. A autoridade afirmou que o acordo concede aos EUA acesso permanente, direitos de base e de sobrevoo, e continuará a vigorar mesmo que a Groenlândia se torne independente. (Reportagem de Gram Slattery e Erin Banco, em Washington, e de Jacob Gronholt-Pedersen e Stine Jacobsen, em Copenhague; Reportagem adicional de Humeyra Pamuk, em Washington)

item.title: Preço do diesel no Brasil encerra semana no maior valor desde maio, diz ANP
item.description: O preço médio do diesel S-10 nos postos do Brasil subiu 2,3% nesta semana ante a anterior, para R$7,13 por litro, maior patamar desde o final de maio, apontou pesquisa da Agência Nacional de Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP), nesta sexta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Marta Nogueira
item.content:encoded: O preço médio do diesel S-10 nos postos do Brasil subiu 2,3% nesta semana ante a anterior, para R$7,13 por litro, maior patamar desde o final de maio, apontou pesquisa da Agência Nacional de Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP), nesta sexta-feira. O avanço dos preços do combustível mais consumido do Brasil ocorre após uma disparada das cotações do petróleo e seus derivados no mercado internacional ao longo deste mês, em momento em que começa o plantio de soja no país, considerado um dos períodos de maior demanda por diesel. O petróleo Brent, referência internacional, fechou nesta sexta-feira a US$104,87 o barril, contra cerca de US$93 no início do mês, à medida que os EUA e o Irã retomaram os ataques mútuos e os houthis, aliados do Irã, também intensificaram suas atividades militares. Desdobramentos dos conflitos entre Rússia e Ucrânia também impactaram o mercado. A escalada de valores no mercado internacional ampliou para [USN:L6N4570ZY TEXT:"níveis recordes"] também a defasagem em relação aos valores praticados pela Petrobras (PETR3.SA) no Brasil, levando importadores no país a adiar decisões de compra e aumentando preocupações com restrições localizadas de oferta e distorções regionais no mercado brasileiro, disseram executivos do setor de distribuição e importação à Reuters. O governo brasileiro tem lançado mão de medidas para amortizar os impactos da alta do mercado brasileiro, com programas de subvenção ao diesel. Entretanto, 30% do combustível consumido no Brasil é importado e nem todos os agentes têm participado das iniciativas do governo. A Fecombustíveis, sindicato que representa cerca de 40 mil postos no Brasil, afirmou em nota nesta sexta-feira que acompanha com preocupação os efeitos da instabilidade do mercado internacional de petróleo sobre os preços e o abastecimento de combustíveis no Brasil e alertou que eventuais aumentos ao consumidor não podem ser analisados exclusivamente a partir do preço exibido nas bombas. "Qualquer avaliação sobre a evolução dos preços deve considerar todo o percurso do combustível: produção, importação, refino, distribuição, logística, tributação e mistura obrigatória de biocombustíveis, até sua chegada ao posto", afirmou a Fecombustíveis. A federação reforçou ainda a necessidade de que autoridades, órgãos de defesa do consumidor e a sociedade analisem a formação dos preços de maneira ampla e técnica, evitando atribuir à revenda variações de custos que muitas vezes têm origem muito antes da chegada do combustível aos postos. A Petrobras informou na quarta-feira aumento de R$1 por litro no preço médio do diesel para distribuidoras, a partir de quinta-feira, acrescentando que houve também concessão de desconto no mesmo valor por conta da [USN:S0N44S05P TEXT:"subvenção"] econômica do governo federal, neutralizando o ajuste.

item.title: Monaco go top of Ligue 1 as woes continue for Lens
item.description: Monaco striker Paris Brunner continued his hot scoring streak as the club kept up their winning start to the Ligue 1 season with a 2-1 win at home over troubled RC Lens on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Monaco striker Paris Brunner continued his hot scoring streak as the club kept up their winning start to the Ligue 1 season with a 2-1 win at home over troubled RC Lens on Friday. Brunner put Monaco ahead in the 32nd minute and piled on the pressure that led to an unfortunate own goal from Lens defender Jonathan Gradit six minutes from time. The home side moved three points clear at the top of the standings with four wins and a draw from their opening five fixtures of the league season. The 20-year-old Brunner has scored six goals this season, filling the void left by the absence of American international Folarin Balogun, who had been expected to move to the Premier League but whose proposed transfer fell through. Balogun was a late substitute for Monaco on Friday for a first run-out since his [USN:L8N43902J TEXT:"controversial appearance"] for the US against Belgium in the last 16 of the World Cup in early July. Conceding late was a blow to Lens, who had been hoping that Friday’s match might provide a turn in fortune after a turbulent week for the club who [USN:L6N4570S0 TEXT:"fired coach Dino Toppmoller"] on Tuesday. Defender Matthieu Udol equalised for the visitors 12 minutes into the second half and they had other chances to score but remain in 10th place with four points. Toppmoller had been in charge for only six matches, coming in at the start of the season to replace Pierre Sage, who left for Crystal Palace after Lens finished second last season. Toppmoller won the French Super Cup over Paris St Germain in his first match, saw the side score five goals against AJ Auxerre in their opening fixture of the league season and win at Sparta Prague in the Champions League, but was still sacked amid accusations of a toxic atmosphere within the coaching staff. Lens said the decision was made after extensive discussions about the squad and the organisation of the coaching staff and that they told Toppmoller they wanted to restructure the set-up. "As Dino Toppmoller could not agree to these structural changes, the club, acting responsibly, has decided to bring his role to an end, as well as that of his two assistants," the French club said in a statement. The appointment of Yannick Cahuzac as replacement has also proved controversial, with Lens sporting director Jean-Louis Leca accused of selecting an old friend for the job despite limited coaching experience and without the necessary licence. The pair grew up in Corsica together.

item.title: Mbappe boosts On's brand visibility, but hurdles to soccer success remain
item.description: On Holding made a splashy entry into soccer on Friday by signing French star Kylian Mbappe, a move that raised the Swiss running shoe brand's profile as it pushes into the sport.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Kaye, Angela M
item.content:encoded: On Holding (49G.BN) made a splashy entry into soccer on Friday by signing French star Kylian Mbappe, a move that raised the Swiss running shoe brand's profile as it pushes into the sport. But On faces difficulties in its bid to translate the [USN:L4N45A123 TEXT:"high-profile partnership"] into a sales boost in the competitive soccer market. The brand, which is battling [USN:L4N4480HG TEXT:"slowing growth"] in its key Americas market, is now tasked with doing what rivals have failed to accomplish: chip away at Nike, Adidas and Puma's soccer dominance. Mbappe previously partnered with Nike for roughly two decades. On, known for its distinctive "hollow pod" soles, missed estimates last month for second-quarter net sales, alarming investors about slowing growth even as it continues to take market share from Nike (NKE.N) and Adidas (ADSGn.DE) . Its shares have tumbled about 40% this year. Still, the company's price-to-earnings ratio of 18.7 values it slightly above sportswear rivals, according to LSEG data, underscoring high investor expectations for future growth. Data from M Science shows On gained market share in the three months through August, while Nike's share losses persisted. Having expanded into tennis in partnership with star player Roger Federer, On is now looking for its next growth engine. Its push into soccer comes against a backdrop of an increasingly competitive sportswear industry, from both a product and marketing standpoint, said Mari Shor, senior equities analyst at Columbia Threadneedle. And soccer is a tough market to crack. "Football is one of the most expensive categories to enter and performance credibility cannot simply be bought," said Jefferies equity analyst Randy Konik, adding that the Mbappe partnership signals that On needs to "spend harder to sustain growth." Adidas [USN:L6N43H187 TEXT:"sponsored"] 14 national teams at this summer's FIFA World Cup, while Nike and Puma outfitted 12 and 11 teams respectively. In a statement, On cited its LightSpray robotic manufacturing technology, currently used for its running shoes, as an asset as it moves into soccer boots. On declined to disclose the financial terms of its deal with Mbappe. But it said the structure includes both cash and equity components. Federer acquired a roughly 2.5% equity stake in On, according to Forbes, when he left Nike to join the company in 2019. SUCCESS STILL UNCERTAIN US shares of On, which also brought in former France star Thierry Henry as director of its soccer business, dipped 0.3% in choppy trading on Friday, a sign that investors are not sold on its high-profile soccer foray. The brand has endured a decline in the Americas, which accounts for more than half its revenue, as shoppers grapple with inflation and an uncertain economic backdrop. Despite the publicity that Mbappe brings, "the question is whether the deal is worth the cost, which is undoubtedly high," said Morningstar analyst David Swartz. Analysts noted Under Armour's (UAA.N) partnership with basketball star Stephen Curry, which helped establish the company in the sport but failed to achieve the cultural influence or commercial scale of Nike's Jordan Brand. The two agreed to [USN:L6N3WP19P TEXT:"separate"] in 2025. In Europe, Under Armour has also tried to gain a foothold in soccer, but the brand has struggled to compete with Nike, Adidas and Puma. "We view this as a repeat of Under Armour's partnership with Curry: a reminder that an elite athlete alone does not guarantee success in a category," Konik said. Still, bringing on Mbappe boosts On's credibility in soccer, said Bruce Winder, an independent retail consultant. The move could spell further trouble for Nike, whose turnaround efforts appear to have stalled, he added.

item.title: Sam Altman, de OpenAI, hablará ante el Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU la próxima semana
item.description: El presidente ejecutivo de OpenAI, Sam Altman, hablará ante el Consejo de Seguridad de las Naciones Unidas la próxima semana, durante la reunión anual de líderes mundiales en Nueva York con motivo de la Asamblea General de la ONU, dijo el viernes un portavoz de la empresa.
item.dc:creator: Michelle Nichols
item.content:encoded: El presidente ejecutivo de OpenAI, Sam Altman, hablará ante el Consejo de Seguridad de las Naciones Unidas la próxima semana, durante la reunión anual de líderes mundiales en Nueva York con motivo de la Asamblea General de la ONU, dijo el viernes un portavoz de la empresa. El Consejo de Seguridad, compuesto por 15 miembros, tiene previsto reunirse el miércoles para tratar el tema de la inteligencia artificial y la seguridad internacional, apenas unas semanas después de que varios líderes del sector pidieron una desaceleración coordinada del desarrollo de la tecnología cada vez más potente, advirtiendo de que pronto podría mejorar por sí sola y escapar al control humano. "Sam Altman informará en persona en una sesión abierta del Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU la próxima semana", dijo a Reuters un portavoz de OpenAI. "Se espera que sus comentarios se centren en las medidas que OpenAI está adoptando para garantizar que la IA sea segura y beneficie a las personas en todo el mundo, así como en la necesidad de una coordinación internacional y de normas de seguridad comunes", agregó. El Consejo de Seguridad de la ONU, encargado de mantener la paz y la seguridad internacionales, se reunió por primera vez para tratar los riesgos de la inteligencia artificial en 2023, cuando China dijo que la tecnología no debía convertirse en un "caballo desbocado" y Estados Unidos advirtió contra su uso para censurar o reprimir a las personas. Altman lleva advirtiendo sobre estos riesgos desde mucho antes del actual auge de la IA. En un ensayo de 2015 titulado "Inteligencia maquinal, parte 1", dijo que "el desarrollo de una inteligencia maquinal sobrehumana es probablemente la mayor amenaza para la supervivencia de la humanidad".

item.title: Trump is talking with Senate's Thune about bill to cut data-center electricity costs
item.description: President Donald Trump said on Friday he is engaging with Republican Senate Majority Leader John Thune about bringing to the floor a bill aimed at protecting households from electricity cost increases tied to the expansion of data centers.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage , Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump said on Friday he is engaging with Republican Senate Majority Leader John Thune about bringing to the floor a [USN:L1N45812Y TEXT:"bill"] aimed at protecting households from electricity cost increases tied to the expansion of data centers. "Well, I'm talking to him about it. We'll see what happens," Trump told reporters on Friday. Lawmakers from both parties have faced growing constituent concerns over rising electricity costs associated with the industry's surging power demand. Earlier this week, the Republican-majority House of Representatives voted [USN:S0N441000 TEXT:"417 to 3"] in favor of the Ratepayer Protection Act, which would require state utility regulators to consider whether large electricity users, including data centers, should bear the incremental costs of power infrastructure built to serve them. An attempt by Senate Republicans to get the bill quickly passed failed on Thursday. Senator Martin Heinrich, the top Democrat on the Senate Committee on Energy and Natural Resources, blocked the proposal, after its sponsor, Republican Senator Jon Husted, requested unanimous consent for a vote without a roll call. Heinrich said the bill did not go far enough by relying on voluntary commitments from states and data center developers. Trump strongly backs data center development as critical to leadership in artificial intelligence. Trump said this week data centers make people and states wealthy, calling them the "oil of the next 20, 25 years." Just 11% of Americans would support construction of an AI data center in their community, according to a recent poll by the University of Massachusetts Amherst.

item.title: US and Denmark reach deal on Greenland, Trump says
item.description: The United States, Denmark and Greenland have entered into an agreement for the US to develop a significant military presence on Greenland, while prohibiting US adversaries from building their own bases on the island, Donald Trump said on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Gram Slattery, Erin Banco, Jacob Grønholt-Pedersen, Stine Jacobsen
item.content:encoded: The United States, Denmark and Greenland have entered into an agreement for the US to develop a significant military presence on Greenland, while prohibiting US adversaries from building their own bases on the island, Donald Trump said on Friday. In a Truth Social post, the US president wrote that no US enemies would be able to make sensitive investments on the island without the approval of the United States and that the agreement had no expiry date. "At my direction, we worked with representatives of Denmark and Greenland to guarantee that the United States will FOREVER have the complete ability to do what is necessary in Greenland in order to secure and defend the security of Greenland, and the United States of America," Trump wrote. Earlier on Friday, Reuters exclusively reported that the US and Denmark were closing in on a deal that would result in an increased US military presence in Greenland, an autonomous territory of Denmark, but would stop well short of Trump's long-held dream of acquiring the island for the United States. The US already has nearly total overflight and basing rights in Greenland due to a 1951 treaty. Trump's announcement suggests he was nonetheless pleased with the outcome of the negotiations and that he might not revive his territorial claims, at least in the near future. He said, without elaborating, that the US would soon be rolling out a large military presence on the island, which already hosts one Space Force base in its remote northwest. "This is a dream come true for the United States of America," Trump wrote. EXTENT OF AGREEMENT REMAINS UNCLEAR The Danish prime minister's office said on Friday that the agreement would strengthen North Atlantic and Arctic security. Greenland's prime minister, Jens-Frederik Nielsen, said in a statement that the agreement recognized Greenland's interests and the Arctic island's place in international cooperation. "This benefits us all," he said. Much was unclear as of Friday night, including whether any new US bases would be constructed as a result of the agreement. Trump's Truth Social posts about negotiations or agreements often lack context or specifics. Imran Bayoumi, a former Pentagon official now with the Atlantic Council think tank, said it would be new if the US can build bases without the approval of Greenland or Denmark but that largely "it seems that Washington could have achieved a lot of these objectives through diplomacy and dialogue without straining the broader US-NATO relationship.” It was also unclear how the agreement would be received in Greenland, an autonomous territory of Denmark. The island's [USN:L4N3YS1QG TEXT:"residents"] aspire to independence and have bristled at US attempts to assert control. In a separate statement, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said that the deal "permanently and completely" addressed Washington's national security concerns with respect to the island. "Greenland will forever be part of the strategic defense area of North America and exclude any adversary from it and the surrounding area," he wrote. A State Department official, speaking on condition of anonymity to discuss specific terms, said the deal prohibits non-NATO countries from building a base in Greenland and will allow only the US and its allies to make unspecified "sensitive investments." The official said the agreement grants the US permanent access, basing and overflight rights, and would continue to apply even if Greenland becomes independent.

item.title: Brentford hammer London neighbours Chelsea 3-0
item.description: Brentford beat their big-spending west London rivals Chelsea 3-0 on Friday with second-half goals by forwards Jaidon Anthony, Igor Thiago and Fabio Carvalho condemning Xabi Alonso's men to their third straight Premier League game without a win.
item.dc:creator: William Schomberg
item.content:encoded: Brentford beat their big-spending west London rivals Chelsea 3-0 on Friday with second-half goals by forwards Jaidon Anthony, Igor Thiago and Fabio Carvalho condemning Xabi Alonso's men to their third straight Premier League game without a win. Anthony pounced in the 61st minute when he nodded in from close range after Jannik Schuster headed a corner back across the goal which extended Chelsea's long run of league games without a clean sheet to 21. Thiago made it 2-0 in the 83rd minute when Emiliano Martinez saved from Kevin Schade on a breakaway but the ball dropped to the Brazilian who made no mistake. Substitute Carvalho wrapped up the win when he turned in a cross by Schade in added time. Schuster said he and his colleagues had turned up the pressure on Chelsea after the break and the approach paid off. "I think when the second half began we played it more directly forward and we scored after that so I’m just happy," the Austrian told Sky Sports. Brentford's win pushed the Bees, who are unbeaten so far in the league, up to third in the table ahead of the remaining weekend fixtures. Chelsea sit in seventh place. It was the first home win for Brentford over Chelsea since 1938 and manager Keith Edwards and his players celebrated at the final whistle, with their fans dancing along in the stands. The usually free-scoring Blues - who had racked up a total of 10 goals in the first four games of the season, behind only Brighton & Hove Albion on 13 - came close early on when Pedro Neto's curling shot was saved by Caoimhin Kelleher. Cole Palmer almost weaved his way through Brentford's defence on two occasions but overall Chelsea, missing in-form Brazil striker Joao Pedro through injury, were comfortably held at bay by the home defence. Alonso made five changes, with captain Reece James also injured. Danny Welbeck got his first league start for the Blues and fellow veteran Jordan Henderson made his Chelsea debut against the club he played for last season. Moises Caicedo remained sidelined due to an injury that has made him miss all but a few minutes of the season so far, contributing to Chelsea's defensive fragilities.

item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta sexta-feira que poderia proibir o acesso de outros veículos de comunicação à Casa Branca, poucas horas depois de anunciar que a CNN, o MS NOW (VSNT.O) e o Politico haviam sido banidos. “Não os quero no meu gabinete”, disse Trump aos repórteres na Casa Branca. “Não os quero aqui. item.title: Superhero-suited Hodgkinson powers to Athlos 800m title
item.description: Keely Hodgkinson ended a rocky season in fine fashion on Friday, shrugging off hamstring concerns to win the 800 metres at the all-women's Athlos London 2026 while dressed in a black, hooded speedsuit that made her look more superhero than middle-distance runner.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Keely Hodgkinson ended a rocky season in fine fashion on Friday, shrugging off hamstring concerns to win the 800 metres at the all-women's Athlos London 2026 while dressed in a black, hooded speedsuit that made her look more superhero than middle-distance runner.
